data.body:
[P2] Validate identity before replay hooks fire

Standard operations enter `DurableContext._replay_aware()` before reaching this validation, and that context manager already emits replay/update plugin hooks from the peeked checkpoint. A type, subtype, name, or parent mismatch therefore publishes stale lifecycle telemetry before this line raises. Validate the checkpoint against the current identity before dispatching either hook, or defer hook dispatch until after this helper, and add plugin regression coverage.
